description: Vault Index evaluation set, version 2 (2026-11-12): 21 synthetic Japanese business documents in Corpus/, cases generated from their reviewed-field stand-ins (fieldTemplates x fields) and hand-written questions in Japanese, Chinese and English. A case passes at document level when a hit is from the expected document, and at passage level when that hit's heading path also contains the expected heading. Version 2 adds three documents whose tables carry the answers: a price list with a Markdown table, and a sales report and an expense claim with HTML tables as Azure Document Intelligence writes them (merged cells, captions). Their table questions have source "table". Version 3 (2026-11-13) adds two documents whose article headings carry no caption ("第5条" only), as older contracts and rules are written: a master outsourcing agreement and a safety rule with chapters. They are what outline navigation with section summaries is measured on. Version 4 (2026-11-13) adds crossQuestions: questions only several documents answer (a listing with a condition, a comparison, a total, a timeline, a link between documents, a whole type), each with the facts its answer must contain, any one spelling of each fact sufficing. Every company named in the corpus is fictional; the company asking is 株式会社ディグナイト.
